scripts.api-tests: npx mocha tests --reporter spec --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=results --timeout=10000
scripts.allure:test: rimraf allure-report && rimraf allure-results && npx mocha tests --reporter mocha-allure-reporter --timeout=10000 && npx allure generate ./allure-results
scripts.test:prod: cross-env ENV=prod mocha tests --require dotenv/config --require ./lib/env-setup.js --reporter spec --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=results --timeout=10000
scripts.test:dev: cross-env ENV=dev mocha tests --require dotenv/config --require ./lib/env-setup.js --reporter spec --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options reportDir=results --timeout=10000
